# #3439 -- the DXIL linker half, driven by measure-link.py
# Every command below is echoed by the script that ran it.
# 'mangled' means the linker's own error named the function
# with its MSVC-mangled symbol rather than its HLSL name.
#
# No release ships dxl.exe, so release rows are a RELEASE MATRIX:
# the local dxc.exe/dxl.exe drivers are held fixed beside each
# release's own dxcompiler.dll, which is the component that
# implements IDxcLinker and emits the message under test.
# Rows tagged (prerelease) are outside the stable sequence and
# outside the headline population count, per SKILL.md step 6.
